Its rear paws dig into ground, spine twisted, foreclaws stretched toward the parent. The parent's huge head recoils in shock, eyes looking down at its own attacking offspring. This is a frightening betrayal, absolutely not play, nursing, grooming or affectionate interaction. The small beast fills lower two thirds of frame, its profile and savage teeth unmistakable; parent fills background and the targeted throat clearly connected to its head. Both animals fully alive and uninjured. The small animal attacks the bigger parent, not the viewer.
